purpose: Exact direct-import exceptions through wave 7. Named composition roots own all enumerated edges after lifecycle and issuance/mileage extraction. This static inventory does not certify complete policy neutrality.
scope: Production .js/.mjs/.cjs/.jsx/.ts/.tsx below server/donna. Excludes *.test.*, *.spec.*, __tests__, __fixtures__, fixtures and testSupport. Relative static imports, re-exports, literal dynamic imports and literal require calls only. Same-country internal imports are country-owned, not engine debt.
limitations: No transitive graph, country literals, runtime flags, country-named root modules, package aliases, or computed import resolution.
Country ownership is the explicitly listed implementation directories; adding or relocating a country implementation requires updating the ownership scope.
Computed imports are reported by the scanner and are outside the edge guarantee.

Named authenticated AE opening intake/read and existing evidence-reply entry points compose the country-owned lifecycle; all journal writes remain on the named common opening writer. U02-S1 real PostgreSQL proves source and owner authority, closure and replay.

The existing evidence resolver hands the persisted AE opening ask to its owned lifecycle after releasing the generic row lock; it must not generically resolve a confirmation without posting. U02-S1 pins the real database reply consumer and ask/journal atomicity.

The authorized thin AE opening adapter validates its exact persisted confirmation and closes the answered ask around the existing private common opening journal body. It does not duplicate journal SQL or select arbitrary jurisdictions.

The thin AE opening adapter records the canonical intake digest in the source receipt. This pure digest dependency is confined to the opening adapter; FI/GB payload identities and all non-opening writers remain unchanged.

Named ordered country inbound composition adds the persisted AE opening reply consumer. The owned adapter rehydrates current identity and actor authority; U02-S1 pins channel reply and actual ask closure.
